interpretation: The fixed Velvia 100F dye basis retains source-linked stock signal relative to the exact wrong-stock bases, but the frozen recorder-RGB affine proxy does not predict target dye coordinates accurately enough.

A direct nonnegative recorder-RGB to measured-density mapping outperforms the factorized dye-coordinate proxy on the majority of held-out rows, so CB4 target-representation compatibility does not become a useful forward model.
These manufactured-target rows were consumed by prior AQ and CB4 work; the leave-one-test-set-and-slide-out role is exact but not a pristine population confirmation.
next_action: Require a materially new source-observable colourimetric or exposure observation on an independent population; do not rescue this cohort with higher polynomial capacity, retuned folds or relaxed gates.
claim_ceiling: Closed recorder-RGB-to-fixed-dye-coordinate forward proxy on existing measured Velvia 100F manufactured-target rows; not a photographic stock response, scanner calibration, independent roll/process confirmation or product profile.
